qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Domestic scale in Dutch pensions and non-life via the Aegon NL acquisition, but operates in a mature, price-competitive market with strict regulatory oversight. Multi-cycle GAAP ROIC falls short of the 12% hurdle, and the ongoing Dutch pension reform (WTP) creates margin and transition uncertainty.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Pricing Power & Proof of Moat, REJECT). Domestic Dutch insurer lacks pricing power in a mature, commoditized market. Operating ROE of 11-13% yields multi-cycle GAAP ROIC well below the 12% hurdle, while the Dutch pension overhaul (WTP) introduces operational and regulatory transition headwinds.
qualitative.evidence: Operating ROE was 11.6% in FY2023 and 13.1% in FY2024 on an operating result of €1,428M and equity of €9.8B. While absorbing Aegon NL consolidated domestic market share, non-life lines face intense competition from NN Group and Achmea. Capital efficiency fails the 12% multi-cycle GAAP ROIC hurdle.
